source.design: pipelined pdpu_top_pipelined, 5 stages of reset-less flops. N overridden from 4 to 16; posit(8,2) inputs -> posit(16,2) accumulator and result, ALIGN_WIDTH=14, CARRY_W=5, SUM_W=19. Identical architecture, formats and rounding to the N=4 reference, so lane count is the only change.
source.port: upstream SystemVerilog -> Spire: structural port with the same five pipeline cut points and the same redundant (sum, carry) form carried across pipe2 as the reference. Clock port uses Spire's standard name `clk`
source.oracle: vectors.dat expected_result is the reference RTL's own output (_debug/gen_vectors.py); the unit is architecturally inexact vs ideal posit math, so reference-as-oracle is the only correct golden
source.testbench: 1,999,992 checked of 2,000,000 streamed (8-vector warm-up skipped; reset-less flops); vectors.dat shared with pdpu_dot16
